notes: Searches the open web via a self-hosted SearXNG instance. Reads SEARXNG_URL env (default http://127.0.0.1:8080). SearXNG fans out to Google, DuckDuckGo, Brave, Wikipedia, GitHub, StackOverflow, arxiv and aggregates the results. No API key, no quota. Candidates carry kind=web_result, id=URL, description=result snippet, and null GitHub-specific fields so the proposal prompt can handle both candidate kinds uniformly.
